# CrypTen {#sec-crypten}

CrypTen is a secure multiparty computation framework introduced by
@knott2022. CrypTen is significant because it takes concepts which are 
well-established within the context of multiparty computation, and 
establishes an easy-to-use system which will feel familiar to 
researchers already know PyTorch. This is extremely important since the
widespread adoption of secure computation techniques up to this point 
have largely been limited to (1) the complexity of primitives associated
and (2) the low-level implementation used by most state-of-the-art 
systems such as Delphi and Cheetah.
